release_name: v1.0.3 - Security Sweep: Playlist RBAC & SECRET_KEY Hardening
features: Playlist write endpoints (update/delete/add-remove-video/reorder/bulk-delete/thumbnail-upload) now enforce real per-owner authorization (was previously unenforced entirely)
SECRET_KEY no longer falls back to a public hardcoded default - generated and persisted randomly on first run
Admin credential reset script now generates a random password and hashes it correctly (was a fixed shared default with a broken hash format)
OAuth/2FA/Signup-Allowlist settings moved into the Advanced-gated Security tab instead of the default General tab
OAuth login (Authentik, Google, GitHub) alongside password auth, with a signup allowlist
Two-Factor Authentication with TOTP support and backup codes
Role-based access control (RBAC) with real per-role enforcement
Native Discord and Apprise notification providers for download/artist activity
Advanced Artist Management with multi-criteria search and bulk operations
Comprehensive Video Discovery with dual-source integration (IMVDb + YouTube)
Professional Thumbnail Management with multi-source search and cropping
Intelligent Organization with automatic folder creation and cleanup
Advanced Search System with real-time suggestions and filtering
Bulk Operations with multi-select editing and batch processing
Video Streaming with built-in player and MKV transcoding
System Health monitoring with comprehensive diagnostics
Database-Driven Settings with complete configuration management
Download Management with queue visualization and progress tracking
Advanced Security with password policies and audit logging
Modern UI with left sidebar navigation and theme system
MvTV Continuous Player with cinematic mode
Robust CI/CD Integration with comprehensive testing and deployment
Enhanced Database Initialization with secure admin user creation
